title: Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more tim
question: Provide the full names of drivers who have been overtaken on track more times than they have overtaken others on track during race laps, excluding position changes due to pit stops (both at pit entry and exit), retirements, or position changes that occurred during the first lap of a race (considered as start movements).

prediction.sql:
WITH race_laps AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position,
         LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_pos
  FROM lap_positions
  WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap > 1
),
pit_laps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap
  FROM pit_stops
),
ret_laps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap
  FROM retirements
),
valid AS (
  SELECT rl.race_id, rl.driver_id, rl.lap, rl.position, rl.prev_pos
  FROM race_laps rl
  LEFT JOIN pit_laps p ON p.race_id=rl.race_id AND p.driver_id=rl.driver_id AND p.lap=rl.lap
  LEFT JOIN ret_laps r ON r.race_id=rl.race_id AND r.driver_id=rl.driver_id AND r.lap=rl.lap
  WHERE p.lap IS NULL AND r.lap IS NULL
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT a.race_id, a.driver_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.position < a.prev_pos THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_overtaken,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.position > a.prev_pos THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS times_overtaken_others
  FROM valid a
  GROUP BY a.race_id, a.driver_id
),
totals AS (
  SELECT driver_id,
         SUM(times_overtaken) AS overtaken,
         SUM(times_overtaken_others) AS overtaken_others
  FROM overtakes
  GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT d.full_name
FROM totals t
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
WHERE t.overtaken > t.overtaken_others;

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH race_laps AS (
  SELECT race_id, MAX(lap) AS max_lap
  FROM lap_positions
  WHERE lap_type = 'Race'
  GROUP BY race_id
),
pit_laps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, lap
  FROM pit_stops
),
retire_laps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, lap
  FROM retirements
),
valid AS (
  SELECT lp.race_id, lp.driver_id, lp.lap, lp.position
  FROM lap_positions lp
  JOIN race_laps rl ON lp.race_id = rl.race_id
  WHERE lp.lap_type = 'Race'
    AND lp.lap > 1
    AND lp.lap < rl.max_lap
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pit_laps p WHERE p.race_id = lp.race_id AND p.lap = lp.lap)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retire_laps r WHERE r.race_id = lp.race_id AND r.lap = lp.lap)
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT a.driver_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.position < b.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overtakes,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.position > b.position THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overtaken
  FROM valid a
  JOIN valid b
    ON a.race_id = b.race_id
   AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id
   AND b.lap = a.lap + 1
  GROUP BY a.driver_id
)
SELECT d.full_name
FROM overtakes o
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = o.driver_id
WHERE o.overtaken > o.overtakes
ORDER BY d.full_name
